web.076b8b8bd6: Editing, search, offline preview, equation conversion, and export run on your device. There are no ads, telemetry uploads, or developer-operated document servers. The app accesses documents you select or open and does not scan other files. On iPhone and iPad, the app stores open tabs, their last saved text, and file access bookmarks in its private container for recovery after a restart. Recovery copies use system file protection and may be included in system backups. When you choose a provider such as iCloud Drive, that provider and your system settings control synchronization.
web.89b45a1ef8: Preferences, endpoints, models, and workflow instructions are stored locally. API keys are stored persistently in the system Keychain and are sent as authentication to your configured endpoint or proxy when an Agent runs. Use only trusted addresses. Copy writes to the system clipboard; paste reads it. Your system settings control clipboard synchronization.
web.a1cdf5d17b: All Agents are disabled by default. Before each remote run, the app lists the receiving services or hosts and the scope of data to send. It proceeds only after you explicitly agree to that transfer. Requests may include task instructions, selected text, context, or the full document. Parallel reviews, consensus, and workflows may also send previous answers to several selected services. The DOCX layout Agent receives only layout instructions and settings. Data goes directly to your configured endpoint. The recipient also receives authentication and connection information, may associate it with your API account, and may keep logs. Retention, training, and deletion depend on the provider's policy; the app cannot promise that every service avoids storage or deletes data immediately. Whether a loopback service connects onward is controlled by its provider.
web.566a7903cf: The MCP / command-line console is available only on macOS, is off by default, and listens only on the loopback address. Except for status checks, document reads and changes still require your confirmation in md any where. An Agent host may process the content you authorize it to read under its own policies.
web.6720138b35: You can decline a transfer, disable an Agent, or choose Clear key and save settings. Disabling a service does not delete its key. Closing a mobile tab removes it from future recovery copies and first asks whether to save unsaved changes; it does not delete exported files or backups. Uninstalling may not clear the Keychain, so revoke unused keys in the provider's account. Deleting local data does not delete data already received by a third party.
web.bac7f2a471: Read PRIVACY.md in the public project at github.com/mrckl-md/md-any-where. For support, use its Issues page or email longshenggdgz@163.com. Do not include real keys, private documents, or unredacted logs in feedback.

web.c2fc799b76:
# Welcome to md any where

Edit Markdown on macOS, iPhone, and iPad, switching between source and formatted preview.

Editing, equation conversion, and export work locally and offline. Optionally connect AI model services for polishing, proofreading, and equation editing. On macOS, the local console also connects to AI editors that support MCP. Content is sent to a remote Agent only when you run it and agree to the transfer.

## Start writing

- Insert formatting with the toolbar or keyboard shortcuts
- Press Return in a list to continue it automatically
- Press **⌘S** to save; opened files support autosave
- Press **⌘C / ⌘X / ⌘V / ⌘A / ⌘D** to copy, cut, paste, select all, or clear selection
- Press **⌘Z / ⌘⇧Z** to undo or redo; **⌘⌥Z** opens history
- Press **⌘T** for a new tab, **⌃Tab** to cycle tabs, or **⌘1…⌘9** to jump directly
- Press **⌘⇧1 / ⌘⇧2 / ⌘⇧3** for editor, split, or preview mode
- Press **⌘⇧G** to insert a Mermaid flowchart, also available to Agents through MCP

## Agents and equations

- Select text and press **⌘⇧A** to polish, proofread, or generate equations with one or more Agents
- Select an equation and press **⌘⌥M** to convert and copy it to Word, WPS, LibreOffice, MathType, or Overleaf
- API keys are stored only in system Keychain; content is sent only when you run an Agent

## LaTeX

Inline equation: $e^{i\pi}+1=0$.

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$

Matrices, alignment, fractions, radicals, and common macros are supported:

$$\mathbf{A}=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}$$

> An open-source project ready for continued improvement.
